name: CM108AH USB audio interface with external ADC

mentions.name: CM108AH USB audio interface with external ADC
mentions.description: An early-stage hardware project building a USB audio setup that pairs the CM108AH chip with an external ADC to achieve lower microphone noise; currently at the datasheet-review stage with PCB design started in KiCad.
mentions.problem: Microphone noise from the chip's built-in audio path; an external ADC is intended to lower mic noise.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm trying CM108AH with external ADC (for lower mic noise). I'm at the stage that I opened datasheets for both and started kicad.
